candidates.readme_excerpt: # OwnVoice Meet **繁體中文** · [English](README.en.md) **聽得懂會議，用自己的聲音回答。** Desktop app for Windows and macOS: live captions and a reply teleprompter for meetings in a second language. 開會時把中文打字變成好唸的英文短句 **[下載 Windows 版（.exe）](https://github.com/Zaious/ownvoice-meet/releases/latest)** · [Mac 版（測試中，.dmg）](https://github.com/Zaious/ownvoice-meet/releases/latest) · [開始使用](#開始使用) *示範：真實流程錄製，提問是電腦語音唸的，右側講稿視窗已調暗。完整、未調暗的錄影見 [MP4 版](docs/media/demo.mp4)（18 秒）。* Gemini Live 聽、Claude Haiku 5.5 翻；語音辨識把 Jane 聽成了 Jinn。右側是作者 2026-10 在 JCDL 2026 用的講稿，數字是當時的。第一個問題的答案在講稿裡；第二個問題作者沒有準備，就用中文打回覆。 我英文看得懂，但開會時常常一下子想不出該怎麼說。用 OwnVoice Meet，你用中文打出想說的意思，它給你一句說得出口的英文，你照著唸。它不替你作答：話是你自己的，聲音也是你自己的。別人說的英文，字幕會即時接上中文意思；事先準備好的回答，就放在旁邊的中英對照講稿裡。 > **狀態：0.5.0 · Windows 10、11 與 macOS 11 以上（Mac 版測試中） · Mac 版的程式內更新還沒實測過。** 程式免費 · 用你自己的 API key 或 ChatGPT 方案，也可以全部在電腦上跑，不用 key、不花錢 · 雲端語音辨識每小時約 0.18～1.02 美元，翻譯選最快一級約幾美分（牌價估算，2026-10-17；見「[服務與費用](#服務與費用)」） ## 它做什麼 - **想說的話，變成照著唸的英文。** 在回覆視窗用中文打、按 Enter，大字英文就出現。它參考剛剛的會議內容和你的講稿，名字和術語會用對。回覆和講稿的 **補對照** 也可以改成你要說的其他語言（設定 → **我說的語言**，預設英文）。在 Zoom、Teams 裡按 `Ctrl+Shift+Space` 就叫得出來；建議放在攝影機旁邊。 - **別人說什麼，馬上看到中文意思。** 字幕視窗即時顯示對方說的話，每句下面接著中文；也可以只看中文。不只英文，日文、韓文、德文、法文、西班牙文、越南文、泰文、印尼文也聽得懂（設定 → **別人說的語言**）。長句講到一半就先翻（約 4 秒後，之後每 2 秒更新），講完再換成完整翻譯。 - **準備好的回答就在手邊。** 講稿與備忘視窗分頁顯示你的簡報稿、準備好的回答和備忘，每行附中文意思，連結和指令可以一鍵複製。直接在視窗裡寫，英文或中文都行：**補對照** 會補上另一半。會自動保存，下次打開還在。真實範例見 [JCDL 2026 講稿](examples/scripts/journal-atlas-jcdl2026.md)。 - **跟不上時看摘要。** 按 **摘要** 打開一個視窗，列出到目前為止的重點，每幾分鐘自動更新（可調，或關掉）。它只整理別人說過的話，不編造，也不建議你說什麼。 - **研討會會場、圓桌論壇也能用。** 收音改成麥克風，錄音和逐字稿存在你的電腦，每個場次一個檔（按 **新段落** 或 `Ctrl+Shift+F9` 切換，名稱可以先貼議程）；網路斷了錄音照樣繼續，網路太差可以只錄音、不辨識。勾選 **標出講者**（設定 → 收音與存檔），每句字幕前面會標「講者 1、講者 2…」，點一下就能改成名字，逐字稿和摘要跟著改；聲紋在你的電腦上比對，聲音不會為此送出去，第一次會下載約 31 MB 的模型。 - **辨識可以完全在你的電腦上跑。** 「聽」選 **本機辨識**：免費、聲音不送出去、不需要 key；英文用 NVIDIA Parakeet，中文、日文、韓文用 SenseVoice，中英夾雜的場合每句自己判斷語言。第一次要下載約 910 MB 的模型，沒有灰字（每句講完約 0.5–1 秒出字）。「翻」也可以選 **本機翻譯**（Qwen3 1.7B，下載約 1.1 GB）：兩個都選本機，就完全不用網路、不花錢、不需要任何 key；翻譯品質不如雲端模型，意思大多對、偶爾用詞不準。本機辨識、本機翻譯與標出講者都只在 Windows 上實際跑過，Mac 版還沒試。 - **分享螢幕時，提詞不會被看到。** 回覆與講稿視窗不會出現在分享畫面、錄影和截圖裡（Windows 10 2004 以上；設定裡可以關）；字幕視窗不隱藏。每個視窗有自己的字級（**A−**／**A+**）和背景透明度；字幕可以讓滑鼠點擊穿過去，操作下面的會議（按 `Ctrl+Shift+F8` 或系統匣圖示恢復）。 ![Demo 模式，不需要 key：字幕、要唸的回覆、中英對照講稿](docs/images/overview.png) *按 **Demo** 就能看到三個視窗

candidates.readme_excerpt: # pratidhvani प्रतिध्वनि, *pratidhvani*: Sanskrit for "echo", a returning sound. Formerly `indic-voice-clone`. Open, self-hosted tools to keep the voices of India's speakers, accent and dialect included. The code is open source under Apache 2.0; no audio is licensed (see [Licence](#licence)). ## Why Much of India's spoken heritage survives only in recordings: lectures, discourses, oral histories, radio archives and family tapes. Commercial text-to-speech offers a few studio voices per language and flattens regional accents, so it cannot bring back a particular person, or the way people speak in a particular place. This project's aim: a family, archive, school or community should be able to take imperfect recordings of someone and produce a voice that sounds like that person and speaks like where they are from, on their own hardware, without handing the recordings to anyone. What it stands for: - **Faithful accent and dialect.** Verbatim transcripts, light-touch restoration, and native-speaker listening tests, not just numeric scores. - **Built for archival audio.** Noisy, reverberant, decades-old recordings, not studio data. - **Sovereign.** It runs locally, so the recordings and the trained voice stay with their owners. - **Consent and provenance.** Only voices with consent. Every generated clip carries a [watermark](#watermark) that `voiceclone detect` can find. - **Measured, not claimed.** Frozen benchmarks, guards against testing on training audio, and a quality gate on every change. - **Open.** Apache-2.0 code on openly licensed models, growing from one dialect towards all of India's languages. Uses it is meant for: hearing a teacher or an elder read new text in their own voice; course material in a teacher's voice and dialect; voice banking for speakers of Indic languages who are losing their speech; restoring and re-voicing archival media with consent; and preserving dialects that commercial voice products ignore. The first test case is a northern Kannada speaker's lecture tapes, cloned on a 16 GB Apple-silicon laptop. ## How it works The recordings are cleaned lightly and cut into short chunks. Each chunk is transcribed verbatim in the dialect, and only clean chunks of the target speaker are kept. Those chunks LoRA-fine-tune the [Svara-TTS voice-clone model](https://huggingface.co/kenpath/svara-tts-voiceclone-beta) in the same "reference-swap"

# MCP Fish Server

<!-- mcp-name: io.github.AceDataCloud/mcp-fish -->

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Fish Audio TTS (Text-to-Speech) via the AceDataCloud platform.
Generate natural-sounding speech and explore the Fish voice model library.

## Features

- **High-quality TTS**: Generate speech from text via Fish Audio models
- **Voice library**: Browse, search, and fetch metadata for Fish voice models
- **Asynchronous tasks**: Submit generation tasks and poll for results
- **Batch task lookup**: Query multiple task results in one call

### One-shot voice cloning

Pass one public HTTPS reference audio URL plus its exact transcript. This conditions only the current TTS request and does not create a reusable voice model:

```python
fish_generate_audio(
    text="New speech in the referenced voice",
    reference_audio_url="https://cdn.acedata.cloud/reference.mp3",
    reference_text="The exact words spoken in the reference audio",
)
```

Use `reference_id` for saved or public voices, and the one-shot reference fields for a temporary voice. Do not combine them. Reference audio supports MP3/WAV and should be 10–270 seconds. Billing remains based on the target text's UTF-8 byte count.

### Find saved voices

Call `fish_list_models` with `self=true` to list voices created and saved through
AceDataCloud by the calling account, including those created with its other API
tokens. This is a list filter, not a privacy setting: saved voices are public and
may be searched and used by others. The voice-creation API's `visibility` input
does not make them private or unlisted; this MCP does not expose voice creation.

Use `page_size` and the 1-based `page_number` for pagination. With `self=true`,
`sort_by` supports `created_at` and `task_count`, and `author_id` further filters
those saved voices. `title_language` is only supported for public library queries,
not with `self=true`. The returned `has_more` is a boolean for account-created
voices but may be `null` for public library queries; use `total` and `page_size`
for pagination in that case. Pass a returned voice ID as `reference_id` to
`fish_generate_audio`.

## Connect: hosted OAuth, API token, or local stdio

The hosted endpoint is `https://fish.mcp.acedata.cloud/mcp`. Choose one route for the MCP client:

# ooxml-integrity

[![CI](https://github.com/Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/ooxml-integrity)](https://pypi.org/project/ooxml-integrity/) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/ooxml-integrity)](https://pypi.org/project/ooxml-integrity/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity/blob/v0.11.0/LICENSE) [![Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/Dmitry-Kov/ooxml-integrity)

An edited Word file can open normally and still have lost a reviewer's comment,
another author's tracked change or a footnote. `ooxml-integrity` finds these
losses after a script, library or agent edits a `.docx`, and finds `.pptx` text
that overflows its box. It runs locally, with no rendering, model calls or network.

```bash
pip install ooxml-integrity
ooxml-integrity check edited.docx --against original.docx
```

```
edited.docx: 2 error(s), 0 warning(s), 1 info
  [ERROR] CMT005  comment id=1 is orphaned - present in comments.xml but anchored to nothing - the reviewer's note is invisible in Word
            -> word/comments.xml
  [ERROR] FID001  comment anchors: 2 -> 1 (1 lost)
  [INFO ] FID014  document: paragraph 15 changed: 'EUR 12,000' -> 'EUR 12,500'
            -> document/p15
```

python-docx changed the fee as asked, and dropped the anchor of the reviewer's
comment on that cell. Exit code `1` fails a CI job; `--json` gives machine-readable output.

**Benchmark.** Thirty ordinary edit requests on two reviewed contracts went to six
document tools and three coding agents. 69 of the 636 attempts that ran damaged
the review record: replies Word does not show, bullets turned into `•`,
another reviewer's pending insertion turned into accepted text. The frozen checker
(0.4.6) reported 41 of the 69. With each task's requested change declared, 0.4.9
reports 65 and 0.8.0 all 69, and both flag 12 of 537 correct outputs, each a true
report outside the benchmark's scope, such as a reply Word does not show. Those
rules came after the benchmark and were measured on the same captures. Counts are
attempts on two documents, not independent documents. [Results](https://dmitry-kov.github.io/ooxml-integrity/benchmark/) ·

# flopsindex

**Reference rates for compute economics** — public price indices for GPU rentals (spot, on-demand, DePIN). Every published value carries a verify URL your code can check against the public index.

[![PyPI · flopsindex-mcp](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/flopsindex-mcp?label=flopsindex-mcp)](https://pypi.org/project/flopsindex-mcp/)
[![PyPI · flopsindex](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/flopsindex?label=flopsindex)](https://pypi.org/project/flopsindex/)
[![npm · @flopsindex/sdk](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@flopsindex/sdk?label=%40flopsindex%2Fsdk)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@flopsindex/sdk)
[![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

---

## Try it in one line

```bash
# MCP server (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT desktop, ...)
pip install flopsindex-mcp && claude mcp add flopsindex -- flopsindex-mcp

# Python REST SDK
pip install flopsindex

# TypeScript / JavaScript SDK
npm i @flopsindex/sdk

# Or skip install — hit the hosted MCP gateway
# https://app.flopsindex.com/mcp   (anonymous, zero-config)
```

Or to your agent: *"Get me the current FLOPS price for an H100 on-demand and show me the verify URL."*

---

## What's distinctive

**Source-opaque by contract.** Every public payload returns a `value` plus citation and verify URLs — nothing about how the value was produced.

**One surface, two access modes.**
- **Anonymous** → delayed public price for the published FLOPS index family (`FLOPS-{model}-{OD|SPOT|DEPIN}`), delayed onto a ~6h grid (as_of snaps to 00/06/12/18 UTC). Indicative reference — not for settlement. The citation surface, designed for LLM/agent discovery and academic reference. The family spans many accelerator models (NVIDIA data-center and workstation GPUs plus AMD Instinct), not just H100 — enumerate the live set via [`/v2/catalog/public`](https://app.flopsindex.com/v2/catalog/public); it grows as coverage crosses the ≥3-source floor.
- **Keyed** (`X-FLOPS-Api-Key`) → the same five tools at full precision.

A **partner tier** with higher fidelity and expanded coverage is available — contact `team@flopsindex.com`.

---

## Features

- **Five key-free tools** — `list_indices`, `search_indices`, `get_price`, `get_index`, `verify`. No API key, no signup, no configuration.
- **Every value carries a verify URL** — check any published number against the index from your own code. `verify` returns whether a cited value matches.

# VerbatimCV MCP server

<!-- mcp-name: io.github.VerbatimCV/verbatimcv -->

Give your AI agent one tool, `parse_resume`, that turns a CV or resume (PDF or DOCX) into verified,
versioned JSON: candidate details, experience with dates, education, skills, languages, and the
candidate's stated preferences (work arrangement, availability, compensation, location, work
authorisation).

- **Every field is quoted from the CV.** Each preference comes with `source` (stated, inferred or
  absent), a confidence and the verbatim quote it came from. Nothing is invented; missing facts are null.
- **Dates are parsed by code**, not guessed, with warnings for year-only or ambiguous dates.
- **Safe to automate.** Hidden text and prompt-injection attempts in the CV are removed and reported.
  Protected characteristics (age, date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo) are never
  returned. `agent_guidance.confirm_before_acting` lists what to check with a human first.

## Set up in Claude Desktop

1. Get a free API key at https://api.verbatimcv.com/account?ref=mcp (50 parses a month, no card). It starts with `vcv_`.
2. Open Claude Desktop → Settings → Developer → Edit Config, and add this inside `"mcpServers"`:

```json
"verbatimcv": {
  "command": "uvx",
  "args": ["verbatimcv-mcp"],
  "env": { "VERBATIMCV_API_KEY": "vcv_your_key_here" }
}
```

3. Restart Claude Desktop. If it can't find `uvx`, use its full path (run `which uvx`), for example
   `/opt/homebrew/bin/uvx` on a Mac with Homebrew.

Any MCP client that runs stdio servers works the same way: run `uvx verbatimcv-mcp` with
`VERBATIMCV_API_KEY` set.

## Using it

Ask your agent something like "Parse the CV at ~/Downloads/jane-doe-cv.pdf and tell me if she's open to
remote contract work." The tool takes exactly one of:

- `file_path`: a PDF or DOCX on your computer (up to 10 MB). Files dragged into a chat window usually
  have no path the server can read; save the file and give its path instead.
- `url`: a public `https://` link to a PDF or DOCX.

The CV is sent to the VerbatimCV API for processing and is not stored.

**Instagram DM automation you own.** Someone comments a keyword on your reel, and they get your DM with the link, in about a second. Story replies, DM keywords, a visual flow builder, a live inbox and your numbers are all included.

## Description

Matomo is the leading Free/Libre open analytics platform.

Matomo is a full-featured PHP MySQL software program that you download and install on your own webserver.
At the end of the five-minute installation process, you will be given a JavaScript code.
Simply copy and paste this tag on websites you wish to track and access your analytics reports in real-time.

Matomo aims to be a Free software alternative to Google Analytics and is already used on more than 1,400,000 websites. Privacy is built-in!

## Requirements

  * PHP 8.1.0 or greater
  * MySQL version 8.0 or greater, or MariaDB version 10.6 or greater
  * PHP extension pdo and pdo_mysql, or the MySQLi extension
  * Matomo is OS / server independent

See https://matomo.org/docs/requirements/.

## Install Matomo

  * [Download Matomo](https://matomo.org/download/)
  * Upload Matomo to your webserver
  * Point your browser to the directory
  * Follow the steps
  * Add the given JavaScript code to your pages
  * (You may also generate fake data to experiment, by enabling the plugin VisitorGenerator)

See https://matomo.org/docs/installation/.

## Develop for Matomo

When using Matomo for development you need to [install Matomo from the Git repository](https://matomo.org/faq/how-to-install/faq_18271/).

This will also give you access to a DDEV environment you can use. More details can be found in the [DDEV README](.ddev/README.md).
